 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The final match before the next international break sees the Rossoneri travel to Genoa's Stadio Luigi Ferraris for Matchday 11 of Serie A . Kick-off for Genoa vs. AC Milan is set for 3:00 PM CET . Here are the official line-ups :
 GENOA (3-4-2-1): Bijlow; Marcandalli, Østigård, Vásquez; Ehizibue, Traorè, Wiafe, Ellertsson; Messias, Vitinha; Osmajić. Subs: Sommariva, Stolz; Drameh, Mitaj, Otoa, Puczka, Sabelli; A. Amorim, Baldanzi, Meichtry, Sow; Colombo, El Shaarawy, Havel, Venturino. Coach: De Rossi.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement AC MILAN (4-4-1-1): Maignan; Gila, De Winter, Diawara, Musah; Moreira, Modrić, Rabiot, Cisse; Pulisic; Ramos. Subs: Bouyer, Torriani; Bartesaghi, Estupiñan, F. Terracciano, Vladimirov; Comotto, Hutchinson, Jashari; Camarda. Coach: R. Amorim.
 Referee : Massa from Imperia.
